assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 宠物场地涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; concept-level only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 宠物登记量、遛宠需求与公园承载力数据仅有公开口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造登记量或客流数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified pet-registration or demand figures are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 数据按三层边界治理：公共看板仅用匿名聚合，运营工单用去标识记录，登记提醒等既有服务流程可用受控可关联记录（最小字段、分离存储、履约后删除）；不跨场景拼接、不做定位画像与个体识别式追踪，关键决策人工复核，并保留更正、删除、申诉和纸面/电话替代渠道。
assumptions.statement_en: Data use is tiered: public dashboards use anonymous aggregates, operations use de-identified records, and existing service fulfilment may use controlled linkable records with minimum fields, separated storage and deletion after fulfilment; no cross-scenario joins, profiling or individual-identifying tracking; human review, correction, deletion, appeal and paper/phone alternatives remain.

assumptions.statement_zh: 本方案提及的公开案例仅作方向性概述，不复制其素材与标识；品牌名为原创概念名，概念阶段未完成官方商标检索，「萌伴智环」「PET·JZ」及各节点名称按内部工作代号处理，限制对外使用与注册，待检索与正式评选确定后再评估对外使用。
assumptions.statement_en: Public cases referenced as directions only; concept stage has no official trademark search; names and marks are internal working codenames restricted from external use until clearance.

assumptions.statement_zh: 养宠管理与分时遛宠机制均为概念建议，实际管理须依法依规并听取公众意见，本方案不替代法定管理职责。
assumptions.statement_en: Pet-management mechanisms are concept suggestions subject to statutory process.
